v.businessProblem: Refunds: replace paper records and phone approvals; cut the average time from refund request to payout from 10 days to 3 days; no refund request is lost and every request is visible to the customer; branch managers decide on their own branch's refunds in one place (REFUNDS 01 Business Objectives 1 to 3). The complaint and portal-share targets of objectives 4 and 5 are open in the BRD. Loyalty: members trust their points balance, measured as zero upheld balance complaints a month (LOYALTY 01 Objective 1, LOYALTY/NFR-01), and check their points without calling a branch (LOYALTY 01 Objective 2, targets open in the BRD).

rows.note: Throughput envelope, not number of nodes. Requires P99 load tests.

rows.label: Mean requests in flight
rows.note: Little’s Law uses mean latency, not P99 or logged-in users.

rows.note: Directional egress is not a separate guaranteed link rating.

rows.note: Sum of directional traffic; not a physical link-speed requirement.

rows.label: Daily API payload transfer
rows.note: Decimal GB; excludes internal and replication traffic.

rows.label: New logical data per day
rows.note: Assumes every transaction contributes its stated logical size.

rows.label: Retained logical data
rows.note: Steady-state simplified model; excludes historical growth and erasure.

rows.label: Planning storage footprint
rows.note: Provider redundancy, snapshots, WAL, logs and backups are not fully modeled.

rows.label: 30-day downtime budget
rows.note: Calendar-time assumption; SLA exclusions may differ.

rows.label: Annual downtime budget
rows.note: SLO downtime budget is not an outage-specific RTO.

rows.label: Hypothetical RPO exposure
rows.note: Potential exposure if peak persisted; not the number of lost committed writes.

rows.label: One-year projected peak API RPS
rows.note: Simple uniform growth scenario; not an adopted business forecast.

rows.label: Ideal migration bulk transfer
rows.note: Only bulk-copy lower bound: excludes transform, CDC, verification and rollback.

rows.label: Proposed address block count
rows.note: Planning block only; no CIDR allocation. Per-provider reserved subnet addresses and IPAM need confirmation.

rows.label: Estimated business read TPS
rows.note: Assumes read fraction applies to business transactions; not DB query rate.

rows.label: Estimated business write TPS
rows.note: Business operations do not map one-to-one to physical DB writes.

rules.assessment: Route to GF-CL; migration is a separate overlay.

rules.title: Independent region/provider failure
rules.assessment: Assess independent recovery locations plus identity, data, DNS, networks and application dependencies.
rules.verify: Prove full service recovery and RPO after the specified failure scenario.

rules.title: Workload-based capacity planning
rules.assessment: Size and benchmark at sustained peak with headroom and failure-mode capacity.
rules.verify: Obtain peak duration, load profile, per-instance P99 throughput, storage IOPS and growth.

rules.title: Near-real-time recovery data
rules.assessment: Measure replication lag/backup point age against scoped dataset and failure.
rules.verify: Exercise writer failure and measure committed-record recovery point.

rules.title: Per-workload data architecture
rules.assessment: Recommend logical data-store pattern; compare provider products and failover semantics.
rules.verify: Validate operations, constraints and benchmarks per workload.

rules.title: Data sensitivity/residency
rules.assessment: Cloud regions, DR copies, data transfers, encryption and access must satisfy applicable controls.
rules.verify: Obtain compliance authority, permitted locations, data lineage and control evidence.

rules.title: One outage can consume SLO budget
rules.assessment: One full-length, user-visible outage in the measurement window may exceed the availability allowance; not inherently contradictory.
rules.verify: Clarify measurement exclusions and design impact on customer journeys.

instructions: Confirm real CIDR/IPAM allocations, public/private subnet eligibility, zone placement, routes, DNS and security/firewall rules; no IP addresses are assigned here.
Provider networking differs: AWS VPCs regional with AZ subnets; GCP VPCs global with regional subnets; Azure VNets regional. Managed service resources may live on provider-owned boundaries.

Verify physically independent recovery network and provider/region/site boundaries. Active-active servicing does not ensure zero client-visible failover time.

dr.summary: Failure scope: region; RTO=4 h; RPO=15 min; candidate: Pilot Light. These are targets, NOT achieved results.
instructions: Define recovery critical path: detection → failover authorization → data promotion/restore → app/IAM connectivity → routing → business verification.
Demonstrate application-level recovery, data consistency, dependency reattachment, failback and split-brain protections.
Document separate recovery objective for every in-scope failure scenario, including cyber/data corruption where relevant.

data.title: Data Flow · Candidate Ownership
data.summary: Only technical data paths are proposed here; product entities, use cases and APIs must come from BRDs.
instructions: Confirm authoritative data owners, transaction boundaries, query patterns, mutation/replay semantics and supported cross-region consistency.
Do not infer product schemas or event names.

security.title: Security Boundaries · Candidate
security.summary: Network trust boundaries are logical; identity provider, data classification and compliance controls need owner validation.
instructions: Validate authentication/authorization ownership from BRD and architecture questionnaire.
Review segmentation, encryption, key recovery, sensitive data location, audit/retention and source-to-target trust.

integration.title: Integration Boundaries · Candidate
integration.summary: Only connectivity and dependency patterns are generated. External APIs and events are unknown until BRD/SDD discovery.
instructions: Inventory upstream/downstream systems and contracts from BRDs, integration owners and source-architecture telemetry.
Validate protocol, authentication, rate limits, idempotency, error queues and cross-site RTT.

deployment.title: Deployment & Fault Domains · Candidate
deployment.summary: Deployable unit boundaries are provisional until BRD scope, selected platform and runtime profiles are confirmed.
instructions: Verify runtime deployment units, rolling deployment, instance recovery, observability and resource sharing.
Do not infer Kubernetes replicas, node counts or physical allocations from TPS alone.
